landing.title: Build your shinobi. Master the deck.
landing.lead: From creation, pick your name and village. Build a 20–30 card deck, unlock talents, and clear solo missions. Then raise your faction's renown, challenge other players, or team up against formidable foes.
landing.guestHint: No password required — you'll choose your name and village right after, then can convert the trial into a permanent account.
landing.asideBody: Preparation decides the fight: card synergies, talents, and village loyalty matter more than raw power. Solo, in a duo, or against a rival — your build does the talking.
landing.timelineRealtime: In a few minutes you set the foundation: a character, a village, a deck, and your first mission.

timeline.fight: Launch a mission, earn XP, Ryos, and cards — then come back to strengthen your village.

cards.collectionLead: Owned scrolls and holes in the catalogue.

chakra.title: 1. Chakra cost
chakra.body: The cyan gem at the top right is how much Chakra this card costs to play. Without enough Chakra, you cannot play it.

figures.title: 2. Damage, armor, and healing
figures.body: Below the cost, the colored gems show the card’s main impact. A card only shows the values it actually has.

effects.title: 3. Effect text
effects.body: Under the name, each line is an active effect: draw, statuses, “After [art]” for chains, cost reduction, and more. The exact values are always the ones written here.

identity.title: 4. Art, element, and rarity
identity.body: The banner shows the art path (Taijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Medicine). The element can grant type advantage. The diamonds at the bottom mark rarity (normal → mythic).

combat.title: Combat
combat.missionsLead: One mission per rank. Each launch rolls a branched path: stake purse, shop, inventory. The briefing opens at start. Death loses the purse.
combat.randomPathHint: Branched path generated on launch — shop and fork on the road.
combat.purseStakeHint: Taken from your Ryos. Lost on defeat or abandon. Road gains add to the purse; the remainder returns on finish.

purse.title: 1. Staked purse
purse.body: Before leaving, pick 0, 100, 200, or 300 Ryos. That amount leaves your account and becomes your mission purse. If you fail, it is lost.

path.title: 2. Path and forks
path.body: After the opening and a shop, a crossroads offers a short or long route. The long one lasts longer and pays more XP at the end.

inventory.title: 3. Inventory (4 slots)
inventory.body: Purchases go into inventory. Use heals out of combat, discard items, or replace a slot when full.

shop.title: 4. Mission shop
shop.body: Spend purse on heals, combat seals, run boosts, or sealed scrolls (revealed only at the end).

finish.title: 5. Commit on finish
finish.body: Nothing credits until victory: remaining purse, XP, reward Ryos, and sealed cards. Defeat voids run loot.
